title: Cornell 7
headline: Cornell 7
whatItIs: The name given to seven Cornell University fraternity members accused in a 2024 sexual assault case.
whyNow: A brand-new article. In mid-September a former Cornell student sued the university and seven members of its Chi Phi fraternity, alleging she was drugged and raped at the fraternity house in 2024. The nickname spread on social media, the local prosecutor reopened the criminal investigation, and Wikipedia now has a page for the case. These are allegations, and at least one of the men has denied them through his lawyer.
